title: Obesity and Liver Function in Oesophageal Cancer
brief_summary: There is an established link between sarcopenia and outcomes in oesophageal cancer. There is scant reports in the literature regarding the influences of different obesity in different compartments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Those undergoing oesophagectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who only had chemotherapy/chemoradiotherapy without surgery
